faq.title: Before you bring us a spreadsheet.
faq.description: Answers for project directors, QS teams, and field supervisors.
faq.q1: Can we import our existing Excel budget?
faq.a1: Yes. Map your existing columns to work item codes, descriptions, quantities, units, and rates. Review validation results and the hierarchy before creating a draft budget.
faq.q2: Do field teams need to install another app?
faq.a2: No. Assigned field reporters use the Telegram Mini App inside Telegram to enter quantities, attach evidence, and submit reports for review.
faq.a3: An addendum creates a new versioned budget draft. Once approved, future reporting uses the applicable version while previously published reports remain tied to their original snapshots.
faq.q4: Does progress value mean actual spending?
faq.a4: No. Value of completed work comes from verified quantities and contract unit rates. It is distinct from actual expenses and cash outflow.
faq.q5: Who can access our project data?
faq.a5: Access is limited by company membership, project assignment, and role permissions. The backend enforces these boundaries on every request.
